title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in basic plans
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's tenant notice, and the documented commands and blocking path are accurate. It appropriately qualifies the uncertain reach of the controls for basic-plan chat; minor corrections concern the licence-checking checklist's citation and table coverage.

claims.claim: The general agent-blocking path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block > Block agent > Save.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... select an agent from the list of agents. ... select Block or Unblock. ... select either Block agent or Unblock agent, and then select Save.

claims.claim: The general Copilot-package blocking operation is POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block, with Planner applicability expressly unconfirmed.
claims.quote: Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage. ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false disables Planner Agent and its chat for all users within the documented scope, with basic-plan chat applicability explicitly unconfirmed.
claims.quote: To turn off Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users: ... Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id> restricts documented access to a security group, with basic-plan chat applicability explicitly unconfirmed.
claims.quote: To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for a specific security group: ... Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>

claims.claim: A Planner-specific admin UI equivalent of the AllowPlannerCopilot tenant setting is not documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent" "AllowPlannerCopilot" "admin center". Opened turn-off-planner-agent, manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps and agent-actions; they document Planner PowerShell and general agent blocking, not a UI for this Planner setting.

claims.claim: A Planner-specific admin UI equivalent of PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId is not documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent" "security group" "admin center" chat. Read turn-off-planner-agent and agent-management results; no UI for PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId was documented. General agent audience settings and the Cowork plugin concern different controls.

claims.where: summary; controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft's notice says blocking Planner Agent removes access to this capability.
claims.quote: Administrators can control access to this capability through agent settings. Blocking the Planner Agent removes access to the feature.

claims.claim: Microsoft asks administrators to review Planner Agent access and settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Review whether your organization wants users to have access to Planner Agent. ... Review Planner Agent settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Indirect cost; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends updating internal documentation and user guidance as appropriate.
claims.quote: Update internal documentation and user guidance as appropriate.

claims.claim: Microsoft says no additional action is required before rollout.
claims.quote: No additional action is required before rollout.

claims.claim: Learn has no feature page explicitly describing this chat in basic plans at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent" "basic plans" "admin" "chat". Read Planner's control page and Copilot release-note excerpts: they distinguish basic-plan task execution from premium chat; the chat release note does not identify a basic-plan scope.

claims.claim: Learn describes Planner Agent as built on Microsoft's security, compliance and privacy approach and links to Copilot's data, privacy and security documentation.
claims.quote: Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat in premium plans are built on Microsoft’s comprehensive approach to security, compliance, and privacy. ... see Data, Privacy, and Security for Microsoft Copilot.

claims.claim: The cited Planner Learn page does not describe basic-plan chat processing in detail.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent chat" "basic" "identity" "processing". Read turn-off-planner-agent in full; its security section discusses Planner Agent and premium-plan chat, without a basic-plan-chat processing description.

claims.claim: The tenant notice does not describe a separate agent identity.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent chat" "basic" "identity" "processing". Read MC1443514 in full and the Planner control page; the notice specifies user permissions but no separate agent identity.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: The sources read do not establish whether a person confirms each basic-plan chat change.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent chat" "basic" "confirm". Read MC1443514, Planner controls and chat release-note passages; none specifies confirmation for each change. Approval text for the Planner Cowork plugin describes a different experience.

claims.claim: Planner Agent chat in premium plans was previously called Copilot in Planner.
claims.quote: The Planner Agent chat in premium plans (previously "Copilot in Planner") offers an in-app natural language chat experience

claims.where: controls[1].note; controls[2].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The Planner PowerShell page covers task execution and status reporting in basic and premium plans but chat in premium plans only.
claims.quote: restrict access to the Planner Agent experience for task execution and status reporting in both basic and premium plans as well as the Planner Agent chat in premium plans only.

claims.claim: Planner policy changes may take up to one hour to take effect.
claims.quote: Changes may take up to 1 hour to reflect across your organization.

claims.claim: AllowPlannerCopilot false turns documented access off for all users.
claims.quote: | $false | Not applicable | 'OFF' for all users |

claims.claim: AllowPlannerCopilot true with no restriction group turns documented access on for all users.
A valid restriction group grants documented access to group members, including nested members.
claims.quote: Users who are members of the specified security group, including those in nested groups, will have access.

claims.claim: An invalid restriction-group ID denies documented access to all users even when AllowPlannerCopilot is true.
claims.quote: If the Security Group ID is invalid, no users will have access, even if AllowPlannerCopilot is set to $true.

claims.claim: Turning off Planner Agent also disables Facilitator's document authoring skill.
claims.quote: Turning off Planner Agent will also disable document authoring skill of Facilitator. All other Facilitator skills remain unaffected.

claims.quote: Planner Agent plans to provide the same auditing capabilities as premium plans (previously Project for the Web projects).
